zh.title: 项目与开源贡献
zh.subtitle: Agent 工程 · 可恢复执行 · 工具可靠性
zh.project_intro: 面向维护长任务中断、重复请求与验收失真，开发可恢复的软件维护运行器，交付补丁及可复查的验证记录。
bullets: 连接 SQLite 检查点与隔离 Git worktree，保留工具进度和失败候选；在本机 ext4 上验证 Deep Agents 正常运行与首个检查点 SIGKILL 恢复，四步参考计划生成相同补丁。
实现固定原版测试验收、Python 语法导出检查与验证进程监督；对补丁、日志、反馈和缓存做哈希校验，拒绝被改写的验收记录。
发送 HTTP 前持久化预留请求次数及 JSON 字节额度，跨重启、跨修复轮次共享；验证 503、超时、在途 SIGKILL 与并发争抢，防止重启绕过限额。
在状态写入及复用缓存前拒绝 NFS 等不受支持的存储；服务器完整回归 100 项通过、零跳过。持锁生成 SQLite 私人备份，源与备份的只读审计结果一致。
zh.project_scope: 恢复采用固定工具计划，不计模型自主修复；历史三仓库控制运行于 NFS，不能证明受支持存储下的恢复。最新 30 分钟 CPU 模型试验保存 4 次回复、5 条读取结果，无编辑、补丁或验收。备份仅用于审计，不证明任务迁移；请求额度不代表 token 或费用。

en.title: Projects and contributions
en.subtitle: Agent engineering / Recoverable execution / Tool reliability
en.project_intro: A software-maintenance runner for interrupted tasks, repeated requests and unreliable acceptance, delivering reviewable patches with verification records.
bullets: Connect SQLite checkpoints and isolated Git worktrees to retain tool progress and failed candidates. On local ext4, normal execution and first-checkpoint SIGKILL recovery produce the same Deep Agents patch from a four-step reference plan.
Add frozen original-test acceptance, Python syntax checks before export and verifier process supervision. Hash-check patches, logs, feedback and cached results to reject modified acceptance records.

Reserve HTTP attempts and JSON bytes durably before send, shared across restarts and repair rounds. Verify 503s, timeouts, in-flight SIGKILL and competing processes to prevent restart-based budget bypass.
Reject NFS and unsupported storage before state writes or cached success. All 100 server project tests pass with zero skips. A locked private SQLite backup reproduces the read-only source audit.
en.project_scope: Recovery uses explicit plans, not autonomous repair. Historical three-repository controls ran on NFS and do not validate supported storage. The latest 30-minute CPU model trial saves four replies and five reads, with no edit, patch or acceptance. Backup proves auditability, not task migration; request limits are not tokens or money.

contributions.name: OpenHands SDK
contributions.text: Preserve undo history after a failed restoration write. Real permission-fault reproduction and 185 related checks pass.

contributions.name: Google ADK
contributions.text: Handle disappearing files during concurrent artifact deletion while preserving nested artifacts. Python 3.11 / 3.13 each pass the same 2,021 related tests with 26 expected failures.

contributions.name: Semantic Kernel
contributions.text: Release the experimental Python runtime token lock before callbacks. 103 related checks pass and real runtime cancellation completes; 12 existing broader-suite failures remain.
